record_title: Boundary-controlled parity reduction in modular Laplacian dynamics
provenance: A source-specific exact refinement of the time-dependent modular discrete-Laplacian dynamics in arXiv:2609.20416v1. Even insertions are erased at the next binary update, while large odd insertions reduce to a boundary-controlled binary correction; this yields exact parity classes and finite-speed localization.
limitations: The boundary-pulse formula for odd moduli assumes binary input and modulus larger than the mask degree. It does not classify smaller odd moduli, prove quantitative density decay, or establish asymptotic carpet persistence or aperiodicity. Originality is assessed to the best of our knowledge.
